recipes.title: Lasagne con Ragù
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. For the ragù, heat oil and brown the meat. Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook until softened. Add wine and simmer until reduced. Add tomatoes, paste, herbs, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 1 hour. Mix ricotta, half the mozzarella, half the Parmesan, eggs, salt, and pepper. In a baking dish, layer sauce, pasta, and cheese mixture. Repeat layers, finishing with sauce. Top with remaining cheeses. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 15 minutes until golden. Let rest before serving.

recipes.title: Riso Basmati con Verdure Saltate
recipes.instructions: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Add to pot with water and salt, bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes. Heat oil in a wok or large pan. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until crisp-tender. Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss with rice, green onions, and cilantro. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Pokè con Riso Basmati, Salmone, Wakame e Edamame
recipes.instructions: Cook basmati rice with water. Once cooked, mix with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Let cool. Prepare all vegetables and salmon. In a bowl, place rice at the bottom. Arrange salmon, avocado, edamame, wakame, cucumber, radishes, and carrot on top. Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and sriracha. Drizzle over bowl. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.title: Cotoletta e Patatine
recipes.instructions: Tenderize cutlets to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat with breadcrumbs. Peel and cut potatoes into fries. Rinse and pat dry. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry potatoes until golden, drain on paper towels, and season with salt. In a separate pan, heat oil and fry cutlets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels. Serve with lemon wedges and garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Carbonara
recipes.instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook guanciale in a dry pan until crisp and fat is rendered. Turn off heat. In a bowl, whisk egg yolks, whole eggs, and grated cheeses. When pasta is al dente, reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain. Immediately add hot pasta to pan with guanciale, tossing quickly. Away from heat, add egg mixture while continuously tossing to prevent scrambling. Add pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce. Season with freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately with extra grated cheese.

recipes.title: Pollo con Contorno di Verdure Grigliate
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken with olive oil, garlic, herbs, lemon zest, juice, salt, and pepper for at least 30 minutes. Brush vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Preheat grill to medium-high. Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Grill vegetables until tender with nice char marks, about 3-5 minutes per side. Drizzle vegetables with balsamic vinegar before serving alongside the chicken.

recipes.title: Pasta con Lenticchie e Patate
recipes.instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic, cook until softened. Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Add lentils, potatoes, crushed tomatoes, bay leaf, rosemary, and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes more, adding more broth if needed. The result should be a thick soup. Remove bay leaf and rosemary sprig. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and grated Parmesan.

recipes.title: Riso Basmati e Pollo al Curry
recipes.instructions: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Soak for 20 minutes, then drain. Heat oil in a large pan. Add onion, garlic, and ginger, cook until softened. Add spices and cook for 1 minute. Add chicken and cook until browned. Add coconut milk and stock. Simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rice with 3 cups water until fluffy. Add peas to curry and cook for 5 more minutes. Serve curry over rice, garnished with cilantro.

recipes.title: Risotto ai Funghi Porcini
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable or chicken stock, hot
recipes.instructions: Soak dried porcini in 2 cups hot water for 30 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid, and chop mushrooms. Filter liquid through a fine sieve. Heat stock in a separate pot. In a large pan, heat 2 tbsp oil and sauté fresh mushrooms until golden. Remove and set aside. In same pan, heat remaining oil and butter. Add onion and cook until translucent. Add garlic and rice, toast for 2 minutes. Add wine and simmer until absorbed. Add porcini mushrooms and their liquid. Gradually add hot stock, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed before adding more. After about 18 minutes, rice should be creamy but al dente. Stir in sautéed mushrooms, butter, and Parmesan. Cover and let rest for 2 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Gazpacho Andaluso
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and roughly chopped
2 tbsp sherry vinegar or red wine vinegar
1 slice stale white bread, soaked in water and squeezed
For garnish: diced cucumber, bell pepper, croutons, hard-boiled egg
recipes.instructions: Combine all ingredients except garnishes in a blender. Blend until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving. Serve cold with garnishes on top and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Gnocchi di Patate al Burro e Salvia
recipes.instructions: Boil potatoes with skin on until tender. Peel while hot and mash immediately. Spread on a surface to cool and release steam. Mix in flour, egg, salt, pepper, and nutmeg to form a soft dough. Don't overwork. Divide dough into portions and roll into 1-inch thick ropes. Cut into 3/4-inch pieces. Optional: Roll each piece on a gnocchi board or fork to create ridges. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Cook gnocchi until they float to the surface, about 2-3 minutes. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan until it begins to brown. Add sage leaves and cook for 30 seconds. Using a slotted spoon, transfer gnocchi to the pan. Toss to coat with butter. Serve with grated Parmesan.

recipes.title: Paella di Pesce
recipes.instructions: Heat olive oil in a paella pan or large skillet. Sauté onion and bell pepper until softened. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook until reduced. Add paprika and stir quickly. Add rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring to coat with oil. Add saffron-infused hot stock and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Arrange seafood on top. Cook without stirring for 15 minutes. Add peas on top. Continue cooking until rice is tender and has formed a crust on the bottom, about 5 minutes more. Remove from heat, cover with a cloth, and let rest for 5 minutes. Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pesto alla Genovese
recipes.instructions: Toast pine nuts in a dry pan until golden, let cool. In a food processor, pulse garlic and pine nuts until finely chopped. Add basil and a pinch of salt, pulse while gradually adding olive oil until mixture is smooth but still has some texture. Transfer to a bowl and stir in cheeses by hand. Cook pasta according to package instructions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining. Toss hot pasta with pesto, adding pasta water as needed to create a silky sauce. Serve immediately with extra grated cheese.

recipes.title: Buddha Bowl con Ceci e Quinoa
ingredients: For dressing: 3 tbsp tahini, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp maple syrup, water to thin
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cook quinoa according to package instructions. Toss sweet potato with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 25 minutes. Toss chickpeas with remaining oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes until crispy. Massage kale with a bit of oil and salt. Whisk dressing ingredients together. Assemble bowls with quinoa, sweet potato, chickpeas, and vegetables. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with seeds.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Classico
recipes.instructions: Beat egg yolks with sugar until pale and creamy. Add mascarpone and mix until smooth. In a separate bowl, whip egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold egg whites into mascarpone mixture. Mix coffee with rum if using. Quickly dip each ladyfinger into coffee mixture (don't soak) and arrange in a single layer in a serving dish. Spread half the mascarpone mixture over ladyfingers. Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers and top with remaining mascarpone mixture. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Before serving, dust generously with cocoa powder and grated chocolate.

recipes.title: Moussaka Greca
ingredients: For béchamel: 50g butter, 50g flour, 500ml milk, pinch of nutmeg
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Salt eggplant slices and let sit for 30 minutes. Rinse and pat dry. Brush with olive oil and bake for 20 minutes until soft. Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan, add onion and garlic, cook until soft. Add meat and brown. Add tomatoes, paste, and spices. Simmer for 20 minutes. For béchamel, melt butter, add flour, and cook for 2 minutes. Gradually whisk in milk until thickened. Remove from heat, add nutmeg and half the cheese. Cool slightly before stirring in eggs. In a baking dish, layer potatoes, then half the eggplant, all the meat sauce, remaining eggplant, and finally the béchamel. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 45 minutes until golden. Let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tacos al Pastor
recipes.instructions: Soak dried chilies in hot water for 20 minutes. Drain. Blend chilies, minced onion, garlic, achiote paste, oregano, cumin, orange juice, vinegar, and cubed pineapple until smooth. Marinate pork in this mixture for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Heat a large skillet over high heat. Cook meat in batches until charred on both sides. Chop into smaller pieces. Warm tortillas. Serve meat on tortillas topped with sliced onion, pineapple, cilantro, and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Ratatouille Provençale
recipes.instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot. Add onions and cook until translucent. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes. Add remaining oil, eggplant, and zucchini. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, bay leaf, thyme, and rosemary. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and sauce has thickened. Remove herbs. Stir in fresh basil before serving. Can be served hot, warm, or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Polpette al Sugo
ingredients: For sauce: 800g crushed tomatoes, 1 onion (finely chopped), 2 garlic cloves (minced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried basil
recipes.instructions: Soak bread in milk until soft. Squeeze out excess milk. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, soaked bread, eggs, Parmesan, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix well but don't overwork. Form into golf ball-sized meatballs. Dust with flour. Heat oil in a large pan and fry meatballs until browned on all sides. Remove and drain on paper towels. For sauce, in another pot, heat olive oil. Add onion and garlic, cook until soft. Add tomatoes and basil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add meatballs to sauce and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Serve with pasta or as a main dish with bread.

recipes.title: Falafel con Salsa Tahini
ingredients: For tahini sauce: 1/2 cup tahini, 1/4 cup water, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 garlic clove (minced), salt
Pita bread, tomatoes, cucumbers, lettuce for serving
recipes.instructions: Drain chickpeas. In a food processor, combine chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, and spices. Pulse until finely minced but not pureed. Transfer to a bowl. Add baking powder and flour, mix well. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Form mixture into small balls or patties. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry falafels in batches until deep brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes. Drain on paper towels. For sauce, whisk tahini with water, lemon juice, garlic, and salt until smooth. Serve falafels in pita with vegetables and tahini sauce.
